# OrbitView

A deck.gl orbit view.

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/orbit-view",
  "type": "OrbitViewOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/orbit-view').par.x` (an input) and `op('/orbit-view').out.view` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.x`, `out.view`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
